OpenSeadragon 6.1.0 is the pinned preview engine for Infrastructure Health & Benchmark 0.1.8.

Expected runtime file:
  openseadragon.min.js

The Infrastructure Health & Benchmark installer uses the following acquisition order:
  1. bundled file in this folder
  2. preserved copy from an existing Infrastructure Health & Benchmark installation
  3. official OpenSeadragon 6.1.0 GitHub release download

If none of these sources is available, the diagnostic raw tile benchmark remains
fully functional, but the visual preview is disabled.

Official release:
https://github.com/openseadragon/openseadragon/releases/tag/v6.1.0
